subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw still backfill signed macOS desktop assets and a beta Sparkle feed for v2026.5.22-beta.1, or should this prerelease be declared npm/git-only under the current beta policy?
rationale: The remaining action changes release policy and requires private release-ops credentials, which automation cannot safely choose or execute.

options.title: Review paired signed-beta path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower successor to establish the beta desktop feed/gate, then run the private release-ops flow for the chosen beta target.

options.title: Backfill this exact beta manually
options.body: Run the private macOS validate/publish workflows for v2026.5.22-beta.1 and publish appcast-beta.xml only if release owners still want that historical beta to have desktop assets.

options.title: Declare this beta npm-only
options.body: Close the tracker with an explicit release-owner decision that v2026.5.22-beta.1 will remain without macOS desktop assets under the documented beta policy.

recommendation.title: Review paired signed-beta path
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower successor to establish the beta desktop feed/gate, then run the private release-ops flow for the chosen beta target.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue depends on release policy and Peter-owned macOS release credential/runbook context, and steipete is also the strongest appcast history owner.
